EXPERIENCE (PRD): My primary breast tumor was 2.5cm.  After consulting with her team, my Sarcoma specialist advised against chemo.  I was NED for 3 years 5 months when it recurred in the left lobe of my Liver.  I began Taxol in September of 2016 & after 17 treatments the lesion had shrunk but other \suspicious\ sub centimeter nodules were noticeable in my lung & abdomen.  I began Lartruvo & Adriamycin in January of this year.  Interestingly, the Liver lesion presented as  if it were gastritis & was quite painful.
